# Where to find the Sheepsquatch and Sheepsquatch meat in Fallout 76

**Used for:**

- Take a Camera Picture of a Sheepsquatch
- Score Daily - Kill a Sheepsquatch
- Score Weekly - Kill a Sheepsquatch
- Kill a Cryptid
- Kill a Huge Creature
- Sheepsquatch Club - Large Sheepsquatch Horns x2
- Sheepsquatch Staff - Large Sheepsquatch Staff x2
- Sheepsquatch Shard - Mysterious Quill x1
- Mutton Chops - Melee damage buff
- Mutton Meat Pie - Melee damage buff

**The Sheepsquatch can drop the following items:**

| **Item** | **% Drop Chance** |
| Sheepsquatch Meat | 100% |
| Mysterious Quill | 100% |
| Mysterious Fur | 100% |
| Sheepsquatch Skull | 100% |
| Large Sheepsquatch Horn | 100% |

__Farming Tips and Tricks__

The following perk cards, magazines, and/or backpack mods will increase your yields.

__Fixed Spawn Locations__

**Skyline Valley**

South River Bridge

Note: The Sheepsquatch will only spawn during night hours (6 pm to 6 am). Check your pip-boy for the time, not the sky.

From the fast travel point, turn to face south and begin running forward.

Cross the river and continue running straight. As you cross the river, grab the three Firecaps on the opposite side.

Keep running until you reach a walking path marked with wooden rails.

Follow this path south up the hill.

When the path splits, take the left path and follow it upwards until you reach the stairs.

Go up the stairs, and the Sheepsquatch will spawn to your right at the top.

__Events/Pip-Boy Dailys__

**Raider Punk** (camp ally) daily quest

- Kill the Sheepsquatch in the Ash Heap
- Kill the Sheepsquatch in the Savage Divide

**Free Range**

One Sheepsquatch will spawn as the end boss for the event in the Forest and Savage Divide.

Two Sheepsquatches can spawn at the end of Free Range in The Mire.

1/3 chance to spawn as the end boss.

1/5 chance to spawn as the enemy during the Red "Boss" wave.

Change for a Sheepsquatch to spawn as the end boss.

__Random Encounters__

Sheepsquatch counts as a Large Creature which means that it can not spawn at some of the smaller encounter locations.

__Assault__

Assault Random Encounter location guide __here__.

**Sheepsquatch Vs Super Mutants**

Only in Ash Heap, Savage Divide, The Mire, and Cranberry Bog

**Sheepsquatch Vs Scorched**

Only in Ash Heap, Savage Divide, The Mire, and Cranberry Bog

**Sheepsquatch Vs Mole Miners**

Only in Ash Heap, Savage Divide, The Mire, and Cranberry Bog

__Object__

Object Random Encounter location guide __here__.

**Sleeping Sheepsquatch**

Only in Ash Heap, Savage Divide, The Mire, and Cranberry Bog

**Empty Sheepsquatch Nest**

Only in Ash Heap, Savage Divide, The Mire, and Cranberry Bog

__Scene__

Scene Random Encounter location guide __here__.

**Brahmin Wrangler**

Only in Ash Heap, Savage Divide, The Mire, and Cranberry Bog

Speak to the Mr Handy and he will ask you to protect his Brahmin while he herds them down the road.

**Sheepsquatch Vs Albino Radstag**

Only in Ash Heap, Savage Divide, The Mire, and Cranberry Bog

__Suggested random encounter farming route:__

**Ash Heap**

Hornwright Air Purifier Site #1 - Object

Hornwright Air Purifier Site # 1 - Scene

Welch - Assault

Hornwright Air Purifier Site #03 - Scene

Abandoned Mine Shaft 2 - Object

Hornwright Estate - Assault

**Savage Divide**

Scenic Overlook - Assault

Dent & Sons Construction - Scene

Dent & Sons Construction - Object

South Mountain Lookout - Scene

Investigator's Cabin - Assault

National Radio Research Center - Object

National Radion Research Center - Assault

Central Mountain Lookout - Object

Fort Atlas - Scene

Sylvie & Sons Logging Camp - Object

Hopewell Cave - Assault

Sacrament - Scene

**The Mire**

East Ridge Lookout - Scene

Braxson's Quality Medical Supplies - Assault

Haven Church - Object

Abandoned Waste Dump - Object

Berkeley Springs Station - Scene

Kmax Transmission - Object

**Cranberry Bog**

Sacramental Glade (Formally Cranberry Glade) - Scene

Veiled Sundrew Grove - Object

Thunder Mountain Substation TM-02 - Object

NAR Repair Yard - Assault

NAR Repair Yard - Object

Overgrown Sundew Grove - Assault

Server Hop and then repeat the route. Remember that it takes 18 minutes for a Random Encounter to refresh so jumping between a private and public server might work better here.

__Ash Heap__

**Hornwright Air Purifier Site #1** - Object

From the fast travel point, run straight over to the Hornwright Air Purifier Site map marker and jump onto the roof of the building. Line up with the Belching Betty map marker and run straight until you get to the road. You should be standing on the edge of the spawn location.

**Hornwright Air Purifer Site #1** - Scene

From the fast travel point, run forward and jump on the roof of the Air Purifier Site building. Face South and you will see two burnt truck trailers in the distance. The spawn location is on the road at the end of the truck trailers.

**Welch** - Assault

Fast Travel to Welch Train Station. From the spawn-in point, turn South and walk forward until you get to the Overseer's Husband's family home.

**Hornwright Air Purifer Site #3** - Scene

From the spawn-in location, turn West and follow the road until you get to the white 83 sign on your right. The spawn location is just behind the sign.

**Abandoned Mine Shaft 2** - Object

From the spawn in location, turn North. The spawn location is in the clearing in front of you.

**Hornwright Estate** - Assault

From the fast travel point, turn South, jump over the digger, and run forward until you get to the road. Face East and follow the road. Go past the fence of tires and the tree laying across the road. The spawn location is in the carpark of the first house on your left.

__Savage Divide__

**Scenic Overlook** - Assault

From the spawn-in point, turn South and follow the road down. Stay on the right-hand side of the road until you see a truck on your left and a large billboard on your right. The encounter location is at the base of the billboard, between the bus and the tent.

**Dent & Sons Construction** - Scene

From the fast travel point, run straight and stand on the top of the yellow dump truck (past the red dump truck). Face SW and jump on top of the yellow digger in front of you. Look West and you will see another yellow digger to your left in the distance. Go and stand on top of the digger and face North. There will be a green pine tree on your left, the spawn point is just past the tree.

**Dent & Sons Construction** - Object

From the fast travel point, turn North and run straight until you hit a cliff face. Turn right and follow the cliff face up the hill. At the top, turn West and follow the cliff edge to the first clearing/spawn location (refer to the photo below).

Keep following the cliff edge along for a second Object spawn location (refer to the photo below). There are two Silt Bean plants on the edge of the spawn location.

**South Mountain Lookout** - Scene

From the spawn in location, run straight towards the tower and jump on the roof of the small red building. Face East and run straight forward until you get to three trees laying on the ground. Turn around and the spawn location is in front of you.

**Investigator's Cabin** - Assault

From the fast travel point, run over to the cabin and stand on the roof. Turn and face East and walk straight down the hill until you see a green roof.

Rare baseball bat spawn __location__.

**National Radio Research Center** - Object

From the spawn in location, turn South and run forward. Follow the brick wall on your right and stop at the corner of the wire fence. Turn SW and walk forward. Climb up the top of the hill in front of you. The spawn location is at the top of the hill.

**National Radio Astronomy Research Center** - Assault

From the spawn in location, face NE and follow the road down. Jump over the tree laying in the middle of the road and continue following the road down. Look North when you get to the Police Car for a fun little scene. Keep running down the road for a little while longer and the spawn location is at the back of the grey truck trailer.

**Central Mountain Lookout** - Object

From the fast travel point, turn SW. Walk slowly down the hill and jump off the small ledge. The spawn location is in the clearing in front of you.

**Fort Atlas** - Scene

From the fast travel point, run around the right side of the main building so you are standing at the back of it, behind the sandbags and defense barrier. Face NW and run down the rocks until you are standing on the train track. Follow the train track North until you see a broken tree trunk on your left. The spawn location will be in front of you and to the left.

**Sylvie & Sons Logging Camp** - Object

From the spawn in location, turn right and follow the road in front of you. The spawn location is just past the large rock in the middle of the road.

**Hopewell Cave** - Assault

From the fast travel point, turn right and follow the road down until you see the orange shipping container on your left.

**Sacrament** - Scene

From the spawn in location, turn West and walk forward. The spawn location is just before the blue and yellow plane crash.

__The Mire__

**East Ridge Lookout** - Scene

At the base of the lookout tower.

**Braxson's Quality Medical Supplies** - Assault

**Haven Church** - Object

From the fast travel point, face South and run down the road. In the water, just before the broken road with the concrete barriers, is the spawn location.

Turn SEE and run over to the large red and white power pylon for a potential rare __baseball bat__ spawn.

**Abandoned Waste Dump** - Object

From the spawn in location, turn around and follow the road toward the green and orange shipping containers. The spawn location is next to the shipping containers.

**Berkeley Springs Train Station** - Scene

From the spawn in location, turn around and run forward until you get to the road. Follow the road NE until you see some road works orange and white signs and witches hats.

**Kmax Transmission** - Object

From the fast travel point, turn NW and walk under the bus. Keep walking NW until you get to the road. Follow the road around and up the slight hill. At the top of the hill, just before the blue animal crossing is the spawn location.

__Cranberry Bog__

**Sacramental Glade** (Formally Cranberry Glade) - Scene

The spawn location in the carpark will be removed when the Once in a Blue Moon patch goes live in June 2023.

From the fast travel point, enter the carpark and walk over to the notice board on your left. To the right of the board is a wooden path. Go to the wooden path and follow it North. Take the first wood path on your right and follow it to the end. Stand on the bench on your right and jump off the lookout. Walk straight and you will see a small stream of water in front of you. Follow the stream until it widens into a small lake (refer to photo). The spawn location will be on your left.

**Veiled Sundrew Grove** - Object

From the spawn in location, turn South and run over to the base of the Monorail rail in front of you. Turn East and you will see a fissure site on your right. Run over to the fissure site and the spawn location is in the clearing, on your right, just before the fissure site.

**Thunder Mountain Substation TM-02** - Object

From the fast travel point, turn West and run forward. Run past the Pitcher Plant and stop at the green road sign on your left. The spawn location will be on your right.

**NAR Repair Yard** - Assault

**NAR Repair Yard** - Object

From the spawn in location, turn SE and line up with the metal tank windmill tower in the distance. Run over to the tower and face South. Go straight and jump into the creek bed. Turn West and follow the creek up until you get to a clearing that splits into three paths. The spawn location will be in front of you.

**Overgrown Sundew Grove** - Assault

Enter the Grove and head towards the house in the middle.
